notes.title: Onsui Content Update - New Modes and More!
notes.content:
A new update hits! New content for Onsui!
Check out [b]Implock[/b], [b]Daily Runs[/b], and the other [i]new features[/i] in this update!
[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2704910/extras/onsuihold.gif?t=1734426418[/img]

[b]New Mode - Implock[/b]
[img]https://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/2704910/extras/implock.gif?t=1734621331[/img]
Introducing the new mode [i]Implock[/i]! In [i]Implock[/i], you'll have to think strategically to reach the 11th Imp rank through merging. Except, unlike the standard and [i]Rising Overflow[/i] modes, you only drop one type of Imp!
This mode requires skilled playing to be able to methodically merge Imps together without overflowing, where you only receive 2nd rank Imps.

[b]Daily Puzzle[/b]
Every day, get a unique and repeatable puzzle. The order of Imps you drop will be the same each time you play, and this order resets as soon as the date changes.

[b]PATCH NOTES:[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Daily Puzzle[/i]: A replayable puzzle which changes every day
[*][i]Meet the Imps[/i]: Added some fluff text to the main menu to describe each of the sentient objects in the game
[*][i]Score Overhaul[/i]: You can now view your highest and most recent scores from the main menu, and the scores of pieces have been tweaked
[*][i]Menu[/i]: Added some new menu pages, as well as interactivity through sounds and visuals
[*][i]Lighting[/i]: Tweaked the lighting to retain visuals while cutting down on the lighting calculations, which may improve your performance
[*][i]Bug Fix[/i]: Fixed an issue with the sizing of the 11th Ranked Imp, as well as some other miscellaneous fixes
[*][i]Lighting Improvement[/i]: Overhauled the lighting in the game to use a different system. Visual difference is extremely minor, but it may improve your performance depending on machine.
[*][i]Forward Rendering[/i]: Swapped to the Forward Shading Renderer to improve VR performance and smoothness.
[*][i]Blur Fix[/i]: Fixed smearing/blurring in the image that was a result of the Temporal Super Resolution effects being applied by changing the Anti-Aliasing method to FXAA.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 16 - SANDBOX PATCH
notes.content:
Hey guys! Thanks for checking out Onsui so far and supporting development of this project and more, you're all legends.

Here is a small patch for you guys.
[list]
[*] Added a custom physics option in the "Modes n' Options" menu that allows you to toggle special physics
[*] Can customise the bounciness/restitution of objects.
[*] Can customise the friction of objects.
[/list]

If you're liking Onsui, remember to give it a review!
